plan.status: pre-specified analysis plan (not an independent registration). Specified after the A1-A3 audit of existing v4-3x10 results and before any result of this ablation was observed.
plan.question: Does baseline-relative spike deviation add measurable attribution value over raw spike activity when the projection mechanism is identical?
plan.primary_metric: P@3 (higher is better); controlled scaled_std magnitude 6.0 and empirical attack donor
plan.unit: paired (seed, fold), J = 30 per dataset; per-unit mean over samples
tests: corrected resampled t-test (Nadeau & Bengio 2003), r = n_test / n_train_normal; a sensitivity analysis for resampling dependence, NOT an elimination of dependence between folds/seeds
Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided) with Hodges-Lehmann estimate for direction
plan.multiplicity: Holm over the 8 primary contrasts, applied separately to each test
plan.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if both Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND mean difference and Hodges-Lehmann estimate have the same sign; both significant but opposite signs -> INCONSISTENT_DIRECTION; exactly one significant -> INCONSISTENT; neither -> NOT_SUPPORTED. Winner label uses the metric direction (higher/lower is better).
plan.effect_size: mean paired difference; corrected-t 95% CI NOT adjusted for multiplicity (Holm is applied to p-values only); Hodges-Lehmann estimate; units won of 30
claim_levels: consistent benefit across the full design requires SUPPORTED delta-better in all 8 primary contrasts (2 datasets x 2 protocols x 2 projections)
partial support -> claim limited to the dataset/protocol/projection conditions that pass

secondary: delta and absdev both better than rho but delta vs absdev not significant -> baseline deviation shows benefit; the additional contribution of sigma scaling is not established (not: shown absent)
no supported advantage -> formulation difference only; no demonstrated faithfulness benefit
secondary: mechanism contrasts among the 6 variants (+RawError, KernelSHAP, Random)
deletion/insertion: log_audc(-), log_auic(+), restricted_deletion_k(-), restricted_insertion_k(-), deletion_flip(+), insertion_flip(+)
plan.secondary_not_conditions: AUDC/AUIC results are reported in full but are not conditions for primary claims
plan.interpretation: faithfulness with respect to the reconstruction score; not causal evidence about attacks; score-based deletion/insertion structurally favours RawError
plan.final_evidence_requirement: all 60 jobs valid under one job-code hash
